summary: Checked the guided-reading notes of Modules 01-05 and every pointer into a paper found in the concept text of Modules 01-07 against the papers (arXiv, CVF, PMLR and NeurIPS copies; 26 PDFs read as text). Most pointers were right. Eleven statements were corrected, in English and, where a Chinese part exists (Modules 01 and 02), in Chinese: five named the wrong or too narrow part of a paper (Belkin, Kapoor and Narayanan, Glorot and Bengio, ResNet's Figure 5, U-Net's augmentation subsection), three placed material in an appendix the cited version does not have (ResNet, ConvNeXt, Pascanu et al.), one claimed a definition the paper does not give (EfficientNet's FLOPs), and two gave numbers without their source (ConvNeXt-T's 28.6M parameters, Chinchilla's unrounded exponents). Four sources could not be opened from this environment (Domingos 2012, Rumelhart et al. 1986, the Patterns version of Kapoor and Narayanan, the JCP version of Raissi et al.); they were checked against preprints or secondary sources, as listed under unverified. check.mjs reports 0 errors for Modules 01-04 and 07.
